This plot is small, only a quarter hectare, and it is rented — not mine. I will not spend much cash on land that is not mine, because next season the owner may take it back. I have my bigger plots to worry about, so this one I keep simple: a little manure from my cattle, local seed I saved, and my own hands. Fertilizer from the cooperative I save for my own land where it pays back over years.
